annotations.title: Check whether domain names are available to register (live registry lookup)

description: Use when the user asks whether a domain is available or taken, wants product, startup, app or project name ideas with a free domain, or is about to put a domain into a plan, README, config or launch post (signals: "is the .com taken", "domain available", "name ideas with a .com", "which of these names has a free domain", ".io or .ai", "who owns this domain", "when does it expire"). Asks each ending's own registry through RDAP (the official successor to WHOIS; IANA's server list plus the registries of .io, .me, .sh, .ac, .us, .so, .de, .ch that are not in it), and returns per domain: available, registered, registered_expiring (redemption or pending delete), likely_available (DNS only: for endings with no public RDAP such as .co, .gg, .eu, .it, or when a registry's RDAP server refuses or rate-limits the check), unknown or invalid; for taken names the registration and expiry dates, days to expiry, registrar, status codes and nameservers, and a flag when the nameservers belong to a parking or domain-marketplace service (Afternic, Dan.com, Sedo, Atom and others: the owner may sell it). Pass full domains, or names plus endings: {"names":["tidewell","brightloop"],"tlds":["com","io","ai"]} or {"domains":["tidewell.com","münchen.de","foo.co.uk"]}. Default endings when only names are given: com, io, ai, dev, app, co, net, org. Up to 20 domains per call. Call it before presenting name ideas as available instead of guessing. Cannot see prices, premium or reserved status, trademarks, or social handles; "available" is not a reservation.

domains.description: Full domain names to check, e.g. ["tidewell.com", "tidewell.io"]. International names (münchen.de) and suffixes such as co.uk are fine; a URL or subdomain is reduced to the registrable domain. Up to 20.

names.description: Bare names without an ending, e.g. ["tidewell"]; each is checked with every entry in tlds. Up to 10 names (and 20 domains in total).

tlds.description: Endings to try with names, e.g. ["com","io","ai","dev"] (a leading dot is fine; co.uk works). Default: com, io, ai, dev, app, co, net, org.
